$comment: The complete tool surface available to Justina's agents.
Agents cannot reach the Expense or Recruitment APIs any other way: there is no generic HTTP tool,
no shell, and no database access. Every entry here lands on a C# command or query that validates,
authorizes and records what it does (§31).

tools.name: justina.session.context
tools.description: Read who the user is, what they may do, and whether a workflow already owns this conversation. Call this first on every turn before deciding which agent should answer.

tools.name: justina.expense.receive_media
tools.description: Register an image or PDF the user sent as a receipt and read it. Returns one or more extracted receipts awaiting the user's confirmation. Never submits anything.

mediaId.description: The channel's identifier for the file.

tools.name: justina.expense.get_receipt
tools.description: Read the current state of a receipt so it can be shown to the user. Omit receiptId to read the receipt this conversation is working on.

tools.name: justina.expense.edit_receipt
tools.description: Change one or more fields the user corrected. Supply only the fields they actually asked to change. The full updated receipt is returned and must be shown again for confirmation.

tools.name: justina.expense.confirm_receipt
tools.description: Submit the receipt as an expense. Call this ONLY after the user has seen the extracted data and explicitly confirmed it. Calling it twice is safe and will not create a second expense.

tools.name: justina.expense.cancel_receipt
tools.description: Discard the receipt in progress. Nothing is submitted.

tools.name: justina.recruitment.search_candidates
tools.description: Search for candidates. Recruitment execution is not connected yet, so this currently reports that the capability is unavailable.

envelope.description: Identity of the current turn. Copy these values from the incoming message; do not invent them.
